rationale: The agent appears to have executed write actions without prior user confirmation. Tool calls show modify_pending_order_items (swapping the jigsaw) and modify_user_address were performed, but there is no evidence of asking the user to confirm these changes beforehand, which violates the stated policy. Additionally, the user requested checking and potentially correcting all order addresses as well as the user address; only the user address seems to have been modified, with no tool call indicating updates to order shipping addresses. While the agent did attempt to identify/verify the user (find_user_id_by_name_zip, get_user_details) and retrieved order details, the lack of confirmation before order-changing writes and the incomplete handling of address corrections mean the request was not completed in line with policy. The abrupt closing (“You’re welcome! Goodbye, Mei!”) further suggests missing confirmation and final information.
